subject: Portal multitenant signer roles + PO prefix resolution for order form
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@procureplus.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Vendor Ops <vendorops@procureplus.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PO prefix collisions during vendor onboarding - quick sync

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. We started provisioning ProcurePlus tenants into your Ariba connector this morning and hit two unexpected behaviors during registration and order routing:

1) PO prefix collision: Our customers send POs with tenant-specific prefixes (e.g., PX-ACME-12345) but the portal is stripping the prefix when it writes the PO into Redwood's order-ack workflow. That causes downstream EDI mapping issues for accounting.

2) Signer routing ambiguity: We have tenant-level signer roles in Coupa — a tenant may allow either a centralized Signer ID or local signers — and the enrollment flow appears to only accept a single signatory identity per vendor. For multi-tenant vendors that serve several clients, that's blocking activation.

I've attached a CSV with the field mapping and a signatory matrix to show the variety of cases. Can you confirm whether the order form will support a clause to preserve PO prefixes and how signatory routing should be handled in the portal?

If helpful, we can hop on a 30-minute call.

Best,
Sarah Miller
Head of Vendor Ops, ProcurePlus
attachments: portal_field_map.csv, signatory_matrix_ProcurePlus.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@procureplus.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-29T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO prefix collisions during vendor onboarding - quick sync

Sarah — thanks for the detailed notes and the CSV. Appreciate the examples; that makes the problem easy to reproduce. Quick thoughts:

- PO prefix behavior: by default our Coupa/Ariba connector canonicalizes PO numbers to a normalized "po_number" field (stripping non-alphanumeric prefixes) to help with matching and deduping. We have a config toggle (retain_po_prefix = false) that can be set per-tenant, but it is not exposed in the standard enrollment UI.

- Signer routing: the portal enforces a single "legal_entity_signer_id" on the vendor record today; we do have a roadmap item for multi-signatory matrices but it isn't shipped yet.

Action items I'm proposing:
1) Legal redline to the order form that requires Redwood to preserve the original PO string as received (we can add a companion field "po_raw" in the payload and keep the canonicalized field for internal use). That protects ProcurePlus's accounting flow.
2) Short-term portal workaround: allow ProcurePlus to register multiple signer IDs via Vendor Ops (manual entry) and map those to tenant routing rules — ops-only feature flag.
3) Mid-term: schedule a product project to support multi-signatory matrices in the enrolment flow.

Kimberly, can you review suggested contract language and advise whether we should accept the preserved "po_raw" approach? Vanessa — can you scope the ops-only feature and estimated time for vendorops to onboard a multi-ID row?

I'll attach a draft order form redline with the clause insert.

—Markus
attachments: orderform_po-prefix-redline_v2.docx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@procureplus.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO prefix collisions during vendor onboarding - quick sync

Thanks Mark and Sarah — reviewed the draft clause. High-level legal position: we can accept the "po_raw" preservation approach but need to add two guardrails to the order form redline:

1) Data retention and PII: state that "po_raw" may include customer-specific identifiers and Redwood will treat it as transactional metadata subject to the existing retention and access controls in the MSA (i.e., retained for 90 days in the online cache, stored in encrypted logs for 1 year) — or allow customer to request alternate retention in writing.

2) Acceptance testing and mapping liability: capture a short escalation path and timelines for mapping failures. Suggested language: "ProcurePlus and Redwood will jointly validate PO mapping in a staging tenant within 10 business days of onboarding; production routing will be paused if mapping failures cause downstream invoice rejection in more than 3% of test POs."

Also: for signer routing, legal is neutral on the ops-only workaround if
- we document the limitation in the onboarding checklist, and
- ProcurePlus signs a short SOW addendum for manual signatory mapping (so expectations on time and errors are clear).

I've limited edits to the attached redline (see comments CS-3 and PO-1).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@procureplus.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T16:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PO prefix collisions during vendor onboarding - quick sync

Sarah — quick operational reply after triage with the onboarding team:

- Ops-only workaround: we can add a repeatable CSV upload to the Vendor Ops console to accept multiple signer IDs per vendor (format: vendor_id,tenant_id,signer_id,signer_role). I'll prepare a sample template and upload instructions. ETA: 7 business days to enable the feature flag in staging.

- PO prefix preservation: we will ship the "po_raw" passthrough param to staging within 5 business days and wire it to the order-ack pipeline so your accounting team can consume it. We'll also add a toggle to opt-out for customers who prefer canonicalization.

Next steps:
1) Sarah — do you accept the order form redline with Kimberly's edits? If yes, we'll incorporate and issue an SOW addendum for the ops mapping work.
2) I'll follow up with the staging schedule and a sample CSV template.

Thanks everyone — tagging the onboarding tracker: HubSpot-Deal-#83421 and the doc note link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Qxz-po-prefix-notes

—Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Onboarding & Integrations
Redwood Inference
attachments referenced: portal_field_map.csv (from ProcurePlus), signatory_matrix_ProcurePlus.pdf
